provenance: Distilled from the request-quality study of the 2026 records campaign (outcomes of 14 agency requests). Campaign-agnostic: agencies, dates and policy numbers are placeholders in square brackets. Citation status is a snapshot; the jurisdiction law package is the source of truth and every draft must re-check it. Nothing here is legal advice.

audit_process.gives: end-user policy includes a periodic system audit process

access_record.gives: operator must keep an access record (date/time, query, username and organization, purpose)

determination_extension.gives: 10-day determination; one written extension of at most 14 days with reasons and expected dispatch date

fees.gives: fees limited to direct duplication cost or statutory fee

duty_to_assist.gives: duty to help identify and narrow records

first_request.exit_ramp: If the agency has not operated or accessed an ALPR system since [date], please say so and treat this request as complete.

items.ask: A native access/search/audit-log export with every recorded field, for the longest period held.
items.redaction_offer: Plate numbers and personal identifiers of members of the public may be redacted; please produce every other recorded field and, for any other withheld field, provide a redaction log or a field-specific written basis.

items.ask: Completed periodic audits under the agency's own policy section [policy_section].
items.if_none: If no completed audit record exists, please say so for this item.

items.ask: The data-sharing list (outbound and inbound), the configuration history of sharing, executed MOUs or approvals, and any review of sharing limits.
The retention setting (a screenshot or export, not policy text) and its change history.
Users and roles, and training dates.
Hotlist agreements and procedures (not hotlist contents).
Contracts, order forms, incorporated documents (master agreement, statement of work, addenda), invoices and renewal terms.

closing: Please contact us before incurring any cost.

wording_rules: Ask for existing records only; never ask the agency to create a report.
No questions in a first request.
One date range per item, stated in the item; ask the agency to confirm the range it produced.
Ask for records sufficient to show the point, not all communications.
Ask for a per-item disposition: produced (which files), withheld (basis), no record located (systems searched), not searched.
Name the produced file and page, and quote the original item text, when following up.
Quote the agency's own policy section by number.
Ask for rolling production and state the fee cap; ask before any cost.
Never ask for plate numbers, hotlist contents or camera coordinates.
Say 'no documented audits produced', never 'no audits'.
Leave unverified citations out of the letter body.

followup_patterns.when: The agency says audits happen but produced no audit documents, or says no records of completed audits.
followup_patterns.goal: Identify the records that would show whether and how audits ran.
questions: Please produce vendor audit-trail entries for running, viewing or exporting audit reports for [period].
Please produce calendar entries, emails or memos assigning or reporting an audit for [period].
Please identify the systems, accounts and custodians searched, per year.
Please provide a per-year answer for [period]; the answer may say "unknown".
We seek existing records only, not a newly created report.
do_not: write 'no audits'; write 'no documented audits produced'
ask the agency to perform or create an audit

followup_patterns.when: The agency closed the request while asked items remain open.
followup_patterns.goal: File a new request that references the closed one, with its own number and clock.
questions: This is a new request. It refers to request [old request id], which your office closed on [closure date].
Please produce the open items listed above, tier 1 first.
Please produce existing records in electronic form on a rolling basis.
do_not: say a reconsideration restarts a statutory clock
mix two request ids in one letter

followup_patterns.when: A written notice extends the time to respond.
followup_patterns.goal: Lock in a dated determination and rolling production of logs and audits first.
questions: Which unusual circumstance applies, and what is the expected date the determination will be sent?
Please release records already reviewed, starting with the lead items, on a rolling basis.
Please confirm the receipt date you are using.
do_not: Call the response late on arithmetic alone.
Treat a second promise as a second legal extension in public copy.

followup_patterns.when: Records arrived but specific items or windows are missing.
followup_patterns.goal: Close the named gap on logs and audits.
questions: Item [n] asked for [requested window]; the produced file covers [produced window]. Please produce the requested window, or state whether it was withheld or not located.
[Template or substitute] was provided in lieu of [requested record]; please produce the requested record or state the basis for withholding.
do_not: Re-request what was produced.
Widen scope inside a clarification; send a separate labelled request.

followup_patterns.when: Whole categories are withheld under an investigatory or confidentiality exemption.
followup_patterns.goal: Get the administrative-field log export and the audit reports, which are oversight records.
questions: Plate numbers and personal identifiers of members of the public may be redacted; please produce every other recorded field and, for any other withheld field, provide a redaction log or a field-specific written basis.
Is a completed audit under [policy_section] a record of investigation? If withheld, please identify it and the basis.
Please list withheld records by category, as the response says segregability was considered.
do_not: Assert the exemption is invalid.
Cite case law before counsel confirms.
Ask for plates, hotlist contents or camera coordinates.

followup_patterns.goal: Keep logs and audits flowing at no or low cost.
questions: Which items does the estimate cover, and on what basis?
Please release electronic records by email or portal without duplication cost, starting with the lead items.
Please narrow to [one quarter] if that removes the cost.
do_not: Agree to or pay a fee; spending needs the owner's decision.
Argue a fee waiver from memory.

followup_patterns.when: The agency says no responsive records exist.
followup_patterns.goal: Either a documented statement that no documentation exists, or the record itself.
questions: Which systems were searched? Was the hosted system's own audit trail searched?

[policy_section] says audits should be conducted regularly. Please confirm that no record of any audit exists (date, reviewer, scope, result), or produce the existing system entries, emails, calendar entries or checklists that reflect one.
do_not: Write 'zero audits'.
Ask the agency to create a report.

followup_patterns.when: A produced record conflicts with the agency's policy or public statement.
followup_patterns.goal: Get the decision records (who changed it, when, approval).
questions: Please produce existing records showing when the [retention or sharing] setting was changed, by whom, and any approval.
For entries [n], please produce records showing the stated purpose and any supervisory review.
attach: both documents, pages side by side
do_not: Characterise motive.
Name individual users in public copy.

followup_patterns.when: No determination after receipt plus the response period (plus any noticed extension), and the mailbox and portal have been checked.
followup_patterns.goal: Get a determination date, then logs and audits.
questions: Please confirm receipt and the reference number, the determination, and the expected date for the lead items.
do_not: Send more than one chaser per checkpoint.
Threaten litigation.
Say 'overdue' publicly unless receipt is verified.

followup_patterns.when: A response cites exemptions or a search without tying them to items.
questions: For each numbered item, please state: produced (which files) / withheld (basis) / no record located (systems searched) / not searched.
The response refers to [phrase]; please confirm which item that refers to.
do_not: Infer bad faith from boilerplate.
